**You don't have to fill all of this in.** A fragment is a complete answer —
"the database name question confused me" tells us more than a blank form does.
If you got stuck badly enough to give up, that is the single most useful thing
you can report here, and it is never your fault.

**Where did you get stuck longest?**
Which step, and what you were looking at when it stopped making sense.

**Did anything look broken, wrong, or alarming?**
Error text, a red message, a page that didn't load, output that just sat there.
Paste it in as-is if you have it.

**What you'd expected to happen instead**
